skill.name: seo-optimizer
skill.description: Audits WordPress SEO fields for Yoast or Rank Math, then reports missing keywords, meta descriptions, and featured images.
skill.summary: Audit WordPress SEO metadata and image readiness for Yoast or Rank Math sites.
skill.author: CrazySwami

security_audit.summary: The skill has legitimate WordPress SEO audit behavior, but it also executes local Docker and curl commands, queries the database directly, and references hidden Claude configuration. No prompt injection was found, but the database access and auto-fix guidance require safeguards before broad marketplace publication.

remediation.issue: External commands access Docker, mysql, and curl.
remediation.suggestion: Replace subprocess calls with vetted Python clients where possible, validate all inputs, and require confirmation before local database access.

remediation.issue: Database queries use hard-coded credentials and interpolated SQL.
remediation.suggestion: Move credentials to user-supplied configuration and use parameterized queries or authenticated WordPress APIs.

remediation.issue: The default base URL points to a real external site.
remediation.suggestion: Remove the default URL or use a neutral placeholder that fails until the user provides a site.

remediation.issue: The documentation references a hidden root Claude MCP config path.
remediation.suggestion: Document a user-configured MCP setup without reading or depending on hidden root configuration files.

remediation.issue: Auto-fix steps can change live WordPress content.
remediation.suggestion: Add dry-run mode, explicit confirmation, backups, and a clear rollback plan before uploads or metadata updates.

content.value_statement: WordPress SEO gaps are hard to find across many pages. This skill audits metadata, keywords, and featured images for clear fixes.
actual_capabilities: Audits WordPress pages through REST API page listings.
Reads Yoast SEO metadata from the WordPress database.
Checks focus keywords, meta descriptions, and featured image metadata.
Scores each audited page and lists recommended fixes.
Can include posts or a configured custom post type.
Provides a documented workflow for Unsplash image selection.
limitations: Requires a matching local Docker database container and credentials.
The script focuses on Yoast metadata and only documents Rank Math fields.
Unsplash upload and WordPress media changes are described, not fully implemented in audit.py.
The default base URL should be changed before use.

use_cases.title: Review page SEO before launch
use_cases.description: Find pages with missing keywords, short descriptions, or weak featured image metadata before publishing.

use_cases.title: Prepare content cleanup tasks
use_cases.description: Generate a clear list of SEO metadata fixes for editors or developers.

use_cases.title: Audit custom property posts
use_cases.description: Check a property post type for SEO completeness across descriptions, keywords, and images.

prompt_templates.title: Run a basic SEO audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit all WordPress pages for SEO metadata. Report missing focus keywords, meta descriptions, and featured images.

prompt_templates.title: Check one page
prompt_templates.scenario: Focused review for a specific page.
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit the about page only. Explain its SEO score and list the highest priority fixes first.

prompt_templates.title: Create an editor task list
prompt_templates.scenario: Turn audit results into content work.
prompt_templates.prompt: Run the SEO audit and convert the results into editor tasks with page names, issues, and recommended wording changes.

prompt_templates.title: Audit custom posts safely
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit pages and property posts in dry-run mode. Do not upload images or change metadata without my approval.

output_examples.input: Audit all pages for SEO completeness.
output_examples.output: A page-by-page report with scores, missing fields, description length issues, and recommended fixes.

output_examples.input: Check the portfolio page and suggest improvements.
output_examples.output: A focused review that identifies the focus keyword status, meta description quality, image ALT text, and next actions.

output_examples.input: Prepare fixes for missing featured images.
output_examples.output: A prioritized action list with suggested search terms, image metadata needs, and approval steps before changes.

best_practices: Run an audit first and review results before making changes.
Use explicit base URLs and confirm the target WordPress site.
Back up content and metadata before applying fixes.
anti_patterns: Do not run the script against an unknown default site.
Do not copy raw SQL updates into production without parameterization.
Do not upload or replace images without editor approval.

faq.question: Does this skill support Yoast SEO?
faq.answer: Yes. The audit script reads Yoast focus keywords, descriptions, SEO titles, and featured image IDs.

faq.question: Does this skill support Rank Math?
faq.answer: The documentation lists Rank Math fields, but audit.py primarily reads Yoast metadata.

faq.question: Can it change my WordPress site?
faq.answer: The script audits and reports. The skill documentation also describes state-changing fix workflows that need approval.

faq.question: Does it need network access?
faq.answer: Yes. It fetches WordPress REST API data and may use Unsplash or WordPress media workflows.

faq.question: Does it need database access?
faq.answer: Yes. audit.py uses Docker and mysql to read WordPress metadata from a local database.

faq.question: What should I verify before use?
faq.answer: Confirm the target URL, database container, credentials, backup status, and whether changes are allowed.
